+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot

+ROOT = Path('/app/runs')
+
+
+def action_from_proprio(spec, now):

+    names = spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
+    for i, name in enumerate(names[3:], 3):

+            joint_name = 'torso_joint' + str(int(name.split('_')[1]) + 1)
+        elif name.startswith('arm_left_'):
+            joint_name = 'left_arm_joint' + str(int(name.split('_')[-1]) + 1)
+        elif name.startswith('arm_right_'):
+            joint_name = 'right_arm_joint' + str(int(name.split('_')[-1]) + 1)
+        elif name.startswith('gripper_left_'):
+            joint_name = 'left_gripper_finger_joint' + str(int(name.split('_')[-1]) + 1)
+        else:
+            joint_name = 'right_gripper_finger_joint' + str(int(name.split('_')[-1]) + 1)
+        a[i] = p[joint_name]
+    return a
+
+
+def save_result(res, name):
+    folder = ROOT / name
+    res.save(str(folder))
+    m = res.meta

+    summary = {

+        'openings': [p['left_gripper_opening'],p['right_gripper_opening']],
+    }
+    print(json.dumps(summary))
+
+
+def main():

+    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest='mode', required=True)

+    b.add_argument('--vx', type=float, default=0)
+    b.add_argument('--vy', type=float, default=0)
+    b.add_argument('--vyaw', type=float, default=0)
